implemented: Added PaperAccountPortfolio as a derived read-only portfolio across distinct per-strategy PaperAccounts.
Consolidates immutable double-entry transactions under book-namespaced accounts and transaction IDs, and verifies both total trial balance and each book cash balance.
Reports per-book and total initial cash, cash, reservations, available cash, fees, realized P&L and NAV; total NAV is withheld whenever any book lacks a current position mark.
Rejects duplicate account objects, mismatched book identifiers, shared journal paths and mixed currencies; explicitly prevents cross-book cash netting.
blockers: The operational runner does not yet discover/register every strategy account into this derived view, and account subledgers remain the source of truth rather than one persisted portfolio ledger.
The scope remains long-only cash equities in one currency; margin, settlement, futures and options accounting are not implemented.
scope_note: This produces a deterministic consolidated audit view for registered paper books. It does not pool buying power or claim cross-asset accounting.
